user.title: BTicino Hometouch Setup
user.description:
Enter your BTicino Door Entry account credentials.

Use the same email and password you use in the Door Entry Touch app.

data_description.num_cameras: How many outdoor stations/cameras do you have?
data_description.num_locks: How many door locks do you have?
data_description.apartment_code: OpenWebNet apartment/unit code for door commands (leave empty if unsure)

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to BTicino servers or provisioning failed

progress.provisioning: Connecting to BTicino servers and setting up your device...

data_description.num_cameras: How many cameras/outdoor stations in your system
data_description.num_locks: How many locks/door openers you have (e.g. gate, main door, apartment door)
data_description.lock_addresses: Full OpenWebNet addresses. Format: Gateway_ID + Lock_Address. E.g. if gateway ID is '2' and locks have addresses 0, 1, 6 → enter '20, 21, 26'
data_description.gateway_address: Local IP of BTicino gateway on your network (e.g. 192.168.1.50). Used for direct video connection
data_description.public_ip: Your public internet IP, needed if HA is behind NAT to receive video. Leave empty for auto-detection
